# Calculating LLM Cost & Estimation Strategies — Exercise Sheets

Work in tables of 3–4. Each lab ends with something written down that you take back to work.

## Lab 1 — The billing unit

*Module 1: The billing unit · about 12 minutes*

**With demo 1** (`python demos/01_billing_unit_and_formula.py`): By hand, on paper: cost one question to your own assistant. Then check with the script. Which line surprised you?

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 3 — Volume and growth

*Module 3: Volume and growth · about 12 minutes*
